# Private plugin API package

Place the privately supplied archive here before installing dependencies:

    clonedspaces-viewer-core-plugin-1.0.0.tgz

The archive is not included in the public starter and is ignored by Git. Do not
commit or redistribute it publicly. If you receive a different compatible version,
update the file reference in package.json and reinstall dependencies.

The host supplies the runtime plugin API. This archive provides the local package
needed to develop, typecheck, and build the plugin.
